topic.title: Guess the gap: two friends invest the same each month for 40 years, one pays a 1% yearly fee

title: Two friends, one 1% fee. Guess the gap 🤔
description:
How much can a tiny 1% fee really cost?
Two friends invest $500 a month for 40 years: one earns an assumed 7% a year, the other 6% after a 1% yearly fee. The gap at 10, 20, 30 and 40 years, computed. No fund or provider named. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
